overview: This House resolution assigns several House members to standing (permanent) committees. It places Representative Conaway on the Armed Services Committee, Representative Grijalva on the Education and Workforce Committee and the Natural Resources Committee, and Representative Walkinshaw on the Homeland Security Committee, and sets where some of them rank in seniority on those panels. Resolutions like this are the routine way the House fills committee seats, often for newly sworn-in members. The House adopted it on November 18, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a routine step that gets members onto committees so they can take part in writing legislation for their constituents.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine internal matter that does not change any law or policy.
